title: Incredible tour

title: Paddle in Seville
text: Fantastic experience for our group of 6 on a hen do. Julio was great and made the whole experience fun and exciting!
author: Stay33061410294

title: Great fun.
text:
This is a lovely experience taking you up and down the river. The river is very calm and our guide, Simon, explained a lot about the river and what you can find such as turtles.
If you’ve never tried paddle boarding, this is a great place to start.
